network.note: Requests to the internet from an app on the bar above, 2026-11-09, fetch() to the body's text: https to apps-api.busy.app and example.com took 1.28-1.70 s, http to example.com 0.09 s. tlsMs is the difference, the TLS handshake on the bar's processor; the emulator makes an https answer wait at least that long.

model.note: The bar's time for an app's work, fitted by emulator/test/speed.mjs to the times above: JS takes opMs per byte-code instruction plus allocByteMs per heap byte allocated; the bar's API answers a request in apiMs plus apiByteMs per byte of its body. work: instructions and heap bytes of the probe's pieces, counted in the runtime of `firmware`.
